brief_summary: To evaluate efficacy and safety of YH16410 versus rosuvastatin and telmisartan monotherapies in patients with hypertension and hyperlipidemia
brief_title: Efficacy and Safety Study of YH16410 Versus Rosuvastatin and Telmisartan Monotherapies in Patients With Hypertension and Hyperlipidemia

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Signed Informed Consent
* Men and women ≥ 19 years of age
* Subject who has one of 3 conditions classified by Cardiovascular Risk Factors, 10-Year Risk, Blood Pressure, LDL-C, TG, Coronary Artery Disease and Equivalent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Females who are pregnant, breastfeeding, or of childbearing potential, unwilling to practice adequate contraception throughout the study.
* Other exclusions applied

official_title: A Double-blind, Randomized, Multi-center Phase III Clinical Trial to Investigate the Safety and Efficacy Between YH16410 Versus Rosuvastatin and Telmisartan Monotherapies in Patients With Hypertension and Hyperlipidemia

primary_outcomes.measure: Change in Diastolic Blood Pressure, Change in LDL Cholesterol
